05.name: Outcome Router
05.job: Central router. Reads opportunity.sale_outcome_v2 and appt_status from Force writes (see to-be/force.json) and routes to the correct downstream workflow. WF-05 never writes any Force field, never creates an opportunity, and never moves opportunity stages. Never fires on MAR. 05.purpose: Central router. Reads opportunity.sale_outcome_v2 and appt_status from Force. Routes downstream. Never moves Sales stages. WF-13 dropped from v2 (Curve owns conversions); SOLD + new goes to WF-06 only.
